documents.title: New visitor badges
documents.text:
Starting Monday, all visitors will need a blue badge. A member of the reception team will [1] each guest a badge at the front desk. Please keep it visible while you are in the building.

Before you leave, put the badge in the white box beside the exit. We use the same badges again the next day. [2]

questions.prompt: Which word best completes [1]?
questions.evidence: each guest a badge at the front desk
questions.paraphrase: give each guest a badge → issue a badge to every visitor
questions.en: The receptionist gives something to someone. Give fits the pattern give each guest a badge.
questions.zh: 前台人员把工牌发给每位访客，give 后可接人和物两个宾语。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes [2]?
options: The white box holds outgoing letters.
Please keep your badge at home.
questions.evidence: We use the same badges again the next day.
questions.paraphrase: use the same badges again → collect them for reuse
questions.en: The return box and the plan to reuse badges make a thank-you for returning them a logical closing.
questions.zh: 出口的回收箱和次日重复使用都说明需要归还工牌，最后一句应感谢访客配合。

documents.title: Subject: Sample jars for the shop floor
documents.text:
Hello team,

Four sample jars arrived this morning. The supplier sent them free of charge so that customers can try the new jam. Please set them on the tasting table [1] the shop opens at nine. Everything should be in place when the first customers walk in.

There is a card beside each jar. Ask visitors to note which flavor they prefer. [2] I will use the results to decide which jam to order.

Best,
Irene

questions.prompt: Which word best completes [1]?
questions.evidence: Everything should be in place when the first customers walk in.
questions.paraphrase: in place when the first customers walk in → ready before opening
questions.en: The team needs the tasting table ready at opening time, so setup happens before the shop opens.
questions.zh: 第一批顾客进来时就要布置好，因此摆放试用装必须在开门之前完成。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes [2]?
options: Put the completed cards in my tray at closing time.
The jars are too heavy for the shelf.
We have already ordered every flavor.
Unopened boxes should go back to the driver.
questions.answer: Put the completed cards in my tray at closing time.
questions.evidence: I will use the results to decide which jam to order.
questions.paraphrase: the results → the preferences on the completed cards
questions.en: Collecting the cards gives Irene the preference data she needs for her order.
questions.zh: 收集填好的卡片，Irene 才有依据决定订购什么口味，与上下文衔接。

documents.title: A shorter wait for bike repairs
documents.text:
At Birch Lane Cycles, we repair both ordinary bicycles and folding models. From April onward, you may reserve a repair slot online. When you choose a time, please describe the problem as [1] as possible. A detailed description helps the mechanic select tools in advance.

Some repairs take longer than the scheduled slot. If this happens, we will [2] you with a revised collection time. Please leave a phone number where you can be reached during the day.

questions.prompt: Which word best completes [1]?
questions.evidence: A detailed description helps the mechanic select tools in advance.
questions.paraphrase: describe precisely → give a detailed account
questions.en: Describe is a verb and needs the adverb precisely. As … as possible keeps the adverb in its base form.
questions.zh: 空格修饰 describe，需用副词 precisely；as … as possible 表示“尽可能……”。

questions.prompt: Which word best completes [2]?
questions.evidence: Please leave a phone number where you can be reached during the day.
questions.paraphrase: can be reached → can be contacted
questions.en: The shop asks for a reachable phone number so it can contact the customer about a changed pickup time.
questions.zh: 店方索要白天能接通的号码，是为了在取车时间变动时联系顾客。

documents.title: Revised shelf labels
documents.text:
Beginning next week, shelf labels in the stockroom will show an aisle number above the item name. The new format should make it easier for temporary staff to find supplies. Old labels already list the correct item names. [1], their lack of aisle numbers has caused delays.

Supervisors will receive a packet of new labels on Friday. Replace labels only on shelves listed in the packet. Several shelves are due to be moved; [2] these shelves now would waste labels. We will identify their new locations next month.

questions.prompt: Which transition best completes [1]?
questions.evidence: Old labels already list the correct item names.
questions.paraphrase: correct names but missing location information → a contrast
questions.en: The passage contrasts a strength of the old labels with a problem they cause. However signals that contrast.
questions.zh: 旧标签名称正确是优点，缺少通道编号却导致延误是缺点，应用 However 表示转折。

questions.prompt: Which form best completes [2]?
questions.evidence: Several shelves are due to be moved
questions.paraphrase: are due to be moved → are scheduled for relocation
questions.en: The action of relabeling is the subject of would waste. The upcoming move explains why it would be wasteful.
questions.zh: would waste 的主语是“现在重新贴标签”这个动作，用动名词 relabeling；这些货架还要搬动。

documents.title: Subject: An alternative collection date
documents.text:
Dear studio members,

A late delivery of clay has affected our Friday firing schedule. Orders marked for Friday collection can still be completed on time if necessary. To reduce pressure on the kiln team, we are asking members with flexible plans to collect on Monday instead. Members who volunteer will receive studio credit. This offer applies [1] to orders originally marked for Friday.

You need only reply if you wish to change dates. [2] Our staff will set those pieces aside for collection at the promised time. Thank you for helping us balance the workload.

questions.prompt: Which word best completes [1]?
questions.evidence: Members who volunteer will receive studio credit.
questions.paraphrase: applies exclusively to → is restricted to
questions.en: The offer singles out orders originally assigned to Friday. Exclusively states this limit.
questions.zh: 优惠对象限定为原定周五取件的订单，exclusively 表示“仅限”。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes [2]?
options: We will cancel all unconfirmed orders.
Monday orders must be collected on Friday.
All replies will be published on our website.
Unchanged orders will remain on Friday's list.
questions.answer: Unchanged orders will remain on Friday's list.
questions.evidence: You need only reply if you wish to change dates.
questions.paraphrase: only reply to change dates → no reply keeps the original date
questions.en: The sentence must identify the pieces staff will set aside and fit the rule that only volunteers need to reply.
questions.zh: 只有想换日期的人才需回复，所以未更改日期的订单仍安排在周五；those pieces 指这些订单里的作品。

documents.title: Subject: Your poster is ready
documents.text:
Hello Kai,

Your blue poster is ready. You can collect it at the side counter of Lane Print after 2 p.m. today. Our front counter is being painted, so please enter through the garden door. Bring the yellow ticket we gave you when you placed the order.

Mara
Lane Print

questions.prompt: Why should Kai use the garden door?
options: The poster is too wide for the front door.
The side counter closes at two.
The usual counter is being painted.
The garden door has a ticket machine.
questions.answer: The usual counter is being painted.
questions.evidence: Our front counter is being painted
questions.paraphrase: usual counter → front counter
questions.en: Painting at the front counter explains the instruction to enter through the garden door.
questions.zh: 邮件说前台正在刷漆，因此要从花园门进入。

questions.prompt: What should Kai take to the shop?
options: An additional copy of the poster
questions.evidence: Bring the yellow ticket we gave you when you placed the order.
questions.paraphrase: received earlier → given when the order was placed
questions.en: Kai was given a yellow ticket when placing the order and must bring it for pickup.
questions.zh: 下单时拿到的黄票需要在取件时带来，received earlier 指当时已领到。

documents.title: West Hall locker notice
documents.text: Lockers 30 through 42 will be unavailable on Thursday morning while a technician changes the locks. Empty these lockers by 6 p.m. on Wednesday. You may use the small lockers beside the ticket desk free of charge during the work. The technician expects to finish by noon on Thursday.

questions.prompt: By when must users remove their belongings?
questions.evidence: Empty these lockers by 6 p.m. on Wednesday.
questions.paraphrase: remove belongings → empty the lockers
questions.en: The deadline for emptying the lockers is Wednesday evening. Thursday noon is the expected end of the work.
questions.zh: 取出物品的截止时间是周三晚上六点；周四中午是预计完工时间。

questions.prompt: What is available at no cost during the work?
options: A set of replacement locks from the ticket office
Other lockers near the ticket desk
questions.answer: Other lockers near the ticket desk
questions.evidence: You may use the small lockers beside the ticket desk free of charge
questions.paraphrase: at no cost → free of charge
questions.en: The alternative small lockers can be used without payment.
questions.zh: 检修期间，售票台旁的小储物柜可以免费使用。

documents.title: Try a Finch desk lamp at your own desk
documents.text:
Not sure which lamp suits your work area? Borrow our display model for two evenings and test it at home. Leave a refundable deposit of $20 at the counter. We return the full amount when you bring the lamp back on time, whether you buy a lamp or not.

The display model comes with a clamp. If your desk has a glass top, ask us for a freestanding base instead. Both fittings are included in the trial at the same price.

questions.prompt: What must a borrower do to get the full deposit back?
options: Keep the original clamp on the lamp base
Return the lamp within the trial period
Purchase a lamp from the shop
questions.answer: Return the lamp within the trial period
questions.evidence: We return the full amount when you bring the lamp back on time
questions.paraphrase: within the trial period → on time
questions.en: An on-time return is the condition for a full refund. A purchase is optional.
questions.zh: 全额退押金的条件是按时归还，购买台灯并非领取退款的条件。

questions.prompt: What does the shop suggest for glass desks?
options: Ask for a second clamp to support the lamp.
Take the lamp without any fitting.
Use the clamp with extra force.
Request a base that stands on the desk.
questions.answer: Request a base that stands on the desk.
questions.evidence: If your desk has a glass top, ask us for a freestanding base instead.
questions.paraphrase: stands on the desk → freestanding
questions.en: For a glass surface, the shop suggests a freestanding base in place of the clamp.
questions.zh: 玻璃桌面建议改用独立底座，freestanding 指无需夹在桌边也能站稳。

documents.title: Packing team · Thursday
documents.text:
08:42 Ben: The printer by the lift has run out of label rolls. Can I use the office printer for today's shipping labels?
08:43 Hana: The office printer only takes plain paper. I put the last spare roll in the top drawer by the lift yesterday.
08:44 Ben: Found it, thanks. I'll get the parcels ready now.
08:46 Hana: Good. I'll order more rolls before lunch. We should have enough for today.

questions.prompt: What does Ben mean by “Found it”?
options: He located a spare roll of labels.
He discovered a new printer setting.
questions.answer: He located a spare roll of labels.
questions.evidence: I put the last spare roll in the top drawer by the lift yesterday.
questions.paraphrase: it → the last spare roll
questions.en: Hana has just told Ben where to find the roll. His reply confirms that he located it.
questions.zh: Hana 刚说备用标签卷在电梯旁的抽屉里，it 指那卷标签。

questions.prompt: What does Hana plan to do?
questions.evidence: I'll order more rolls before lunch.
questions.paraphrase: replenish the supply → order more rolls
questions.en: Hana says she will order additional rolls before lunch.
questions.zh: Hana 要在午饭前订更多标签卷，replenish 表示“补充”。

documents.title: New starter morning · original plan
documents.text:
09:00–09:30  Welcome and building tour · Reception
09:30–10:15  Safe lifting demonstration · Loading Bay
10:15–10:30  Break · Staff Room
10:30–11:15  Customer calls practice · Room C

Please bring your training folder to all sessions.

documents.title: Subject: Tomorrow’s demonstration
documents.text:
Hello everyone,

The instructor for the safe lifting demonstration will show a video indoors because of heavy rain. Meet in Room B at the time shown on the plan. All other sessions and times remain as listed.

Eli, Training Coordinator

questions.prompt: Where should trainees be at 9:30?
questions.evidence: Meet in Room B at the time shown on the plan.
questions.paraphrase: at the time shown → at the original 09:30 start
questions.en: The plan sets safe lifting for 09:30. The email replaces its Loading Bay venue with Room B.
questions.zh: 日程把搬运示范定在 9:30，新邮件要求同一时间在 B 室集合，地点取新、时间照旧。

questions.prompt: Which activity will still take place in Room C?
options: Taking a guided tour of the receiving area
questions.evidence: 10:30–11:15  Customer calls practice · Room C
questions.paraphrase: practicing calls with customers → customer calls practice
questions.en: The plan puts call practice in Room C, and the email leaves every session other than safe lifting unchanged.
questions.zh: 原日程中 C 室安排客户电话练习。邮件只调整搬运示范，所以该活动照常。

questions.prompt: What should trainees bring to the indoor demonstration?
questions.evidence: Please bring your training folder to all sessions.
questions.paraphrase: all sessions → includes the relocated demonstration
questions.en: The email changes the venue and method only; the original bring-your-folder instruction still applies.
questions.zh: 新邮件只改示范地点和形式，原来每场都带培训文件夹的要求仍适用。

questions.prompt: Why will the instructor use a video?
options: The welcome tour will run late.
Room C has the only working screen.
questions.evidence: because of heavy rain
questions.paraphrase: heavy rain → weather forces indoor instruction
questions.en: The email explicitly gives heavy rain as the reason for moving the demonstration indoors.
questions.zh: 邮件直接说明因大雨改为室内视频示范。

questions.prompt: How much time separates the end of safe lifting and the start of call practice?
questions.paraphrase: unchanged break → fifteen-minute gap
questions.en: The email keeps all times. The original plan ends safe lifting at 10:15 and starts call practice at 10:30.
questions.zh: 邮件说时间不变，示范 10:15 结束，电话练习 10:30 开始，中间 15 分钟。

documents.title: Leaf Cart · four-week rentals
documents.text:
Standard pot: $12 per pot. Watering by the customer.
Service pot: $18 per pot. Includes one watering visit per week.
Delivery is free for orders of five pots or more. For smaller orders, add $8 per delivery. Pots must be returned to the counter after four weeks.

documents.title: Subject: Plants for the reception area
documents.text:
Hello Leaf Cart,

Please reserve four standard pots for our reception area for four weeks. Our caretaker is happy to water them. We will need delivery, as the pots will not fit on our trolley. I can return them myself when the rental ends.

Tan, Office Coordinator

questions.prompt: What is the total rental and delivery charge for Tan's request?
questions.evidence: For smaller orders, add $8 per delivery.
questions.paraphrase: four standard pots → four at $12, below the free-delivery threshold
questions.en: Four standard pots cost $48. Four is fewer than five, so the $8 delivery charge makes the total $56.
questions.zh: 四盆标准款共 48 美元。数量未到五盆，需加 8 美元配送费，合计 56 美元。

questions.prompt: Which service will Tan's team provide for itself during the rental?
questions.evidence: Our caretaker is happy to water them.
questions.paraphrase: provide for itself → handled by the customer's caretaker
questions.en: The quote assigns watering to customers on the standard plan. Tan confirms that a caretaker will do it.
questions.zh: 报价单说明标准款由客户浇水，邮件确认会由管理员照料。

questions.prompt: Which expense would disappear if Tan ordered one more pot under the same delivery terms?
options: The cost of every standard pot
The trip to deliver the pots
The charge for a service pot
questions.answer: The trip to deliver the pots
questions.evidence: Delivery is free for orders of five pots or more.
questions.paraphrase: one more than four → five, qualifying for free delivery
questions.en: The email asks for four pots; adding one reaches the quote's free-delivery threshold.
questions.zh: 现要四盆，再加一盆就满足报价的五盆免配送门槛。

questions.prompt: What will Tan do when the rental ends?
questions.evidence: I can return them myself when the rental ends.
questions.paraphrase: in person → myself
questions.en: The quotation requires a counter return, and Tan offers to handle it personally.
questions.zh: 报价要求送回柜台，Tan 说自己可以归还。

questions.prompt: Which feature distinguishes the service pot from Tan's choice?
questions.evidence: Includes one watering visit per week.
questions.paraphrase: service pot → supplier visits weekly
questions.en: The service plan includes a weekly visit. Tan's standard pots require customer watering.
questions.zh: 服务款包括每周上门浇水；Tan 选的标准款要由客户浇水。

documents.title: Order 814 · display stands
documents.text: Birch Books ordered six narrow display stands for its East and West branches. Purchase note: send four to East and two to West. Both branches need their stands before Saturday's display change. No substitutions without approval.

documents.title: Friday · route sheet
documents.text:
10:10 — East branch: three narrow stands delivered; receipt signed by Lee.
10:55 — West branch: three narrow stands delivered; receipt signed by Dara.
No damaged units reported. Van returns to the depot at 13:00.

documents.title: Branch coordinators · Friday
documents.text:
11:15 Lee: We can assemble ours this afternoon if the numbers are corrected.
11:17 Dara: I have checked the stockroom here. The spare is still packed. Our shuttle leaves for your branch at noon, so I can put it on board.
11:20 Lee: Yes, please. I'll meet the shuttle at our rear door.

questions.prompt: Why does Dara refer to a stand as “the spare”?
options: West took an unlisted stand to replace a damaged unit.
West received one more stand than it ordered.
questions.answer: West received one more stand than it ordered.
questions.evidence: 10:55 — West branch: three narrow stands delivered
questions.paraphrase: two requested versus three delivered → one extra
questions.en: The purchase note allocates two units to West. The route sheet records three delivered there, leaving one extra.
questions.zh: 订单给西店分配两台，送货记录却是三台，所以西店有一台多出来的展架。

questions.prompt: How will the order most likely be corrected?
options: Both stores will wait for a new order on Saturday.
East will send one assembled stand to West.
One packed stand will travel from West to East on the noon shuttle.
The delivery van will collect all six stands at one.
questions.answer: One packed stand will travel from West to East on the noon shuttle.
questions.evidence: Our shuttle leaves for your branch at noon, so I can put it on board.
questions.paraphrase: put it on board → send the extra stand on the shuttle
questions.en: Dara offers to send West's surplus to Lee at East, which received three of its four stands. Lee agrees.
questions.zh: 东店应收四台却只有三台，西店正好多一台。Dara 提议用中午班车运过去，Lee 已同意。

questions.prompt: Which part of the purchase note was followed despite the allocation error?
options: The site split specified by Birch
questions.evidence: three narrow stands delivered
questions.paraphrase: narrow models delivered → model requirement met
questions.en: Both route entries identify narrow stands, matching the purchase note's requested model.
questions.zh: 两条送货记录均注明窄款，与订单要求的型号一致，错误在分店分配。

questions.prompt: What does Lee imply by “if the numbers are corrected”?
questions.evidence: East branch: three narrow stands delivered
questions.paraphrase: three received versus four requested → one still needed
questions.en: Lee represents East. It has three units and needs the fourth before completing its intended setup.
questions.zh: Lee 在东店，订单分配四台却只送到三台，所以还差一台。

questions.prompt: When is the suggested transfer scheduled compared with the van's return?
questions.evidence: Van returns to the depot at 13:00.
questions.paraphrase: noon shuttle versus 13:00 van → one hour earlier
questions.en: Dara proposes the noon shuttle. The route sheet places the van's return at 13:00.
questions.zh: 聊天里的班车中午出发，路线单上的货车下午一点回库，前者早一小时。

documents.title: Foldline Press · proof and print policy
documents.text: The quoted price includes one digital proof and one round of customer corrections. A further round requested by the customer costs $35. Changes needed to resolve errors introduced by our production team are free and do not count toward the included round. Printing starts only after written approval of the final proof.

documents.title: From: J. Moss, Garden Walks · Proof 1
documents.text: The route map looks right. We sent you an outdated meeting time in our original file; please change 8:15 to 8:45 on page two. No other revisions from us. Please send the updated proof before printing.

documents.title: From: Foldline production · Proof 2
documents.text: We changed the time as requested. During that edit we accidentally moved the map key over the north arrow. Our designer will restore the map key this afternoon and send Proof 3. Please reply to that version with your approval if everything is in order.

questions.prompt: Why should fixing the map key leave the invoice total unchanged?
options: All changes are free before the first print run.
The printer introduced the layout error.
The customer still has two free revision rounds.
The customer supplied a replacement map.
questions.answer: The printer introduced the layout error.
questions.evidence: During that edit we accidentally moved the map key over the north arrow.
questions.paraphrase: printer introduced the layout error → production team accidentally moved the key
questions.en: The meeting-time correction uses the included customer round. The printer caused the map error, which the terms say it must correct for free.
questions.zh: 更正集合时间占用一轮客户修改；图例错位由印厂造成，根据条款应免费修正。

questions.prompt: What must happen after Foldline restores the map key and before printing begins?
options: Garden Walks must approve the new proof in writing.
The designer must remove the north arrow.
Garden Walks must submit a signed request for a second invoice.
Production must restore the original meeting time.
questions.answer: Garden Walks must approve the new proof in writing.
questions.evidence: Printing starts only after written approval of the final proof.
questions.paraphrase: approve the new proof in writing → reply to Proof 3 with approval
questions.en: Proof 3 is the corrected version. The policy requires written approval, and the latest email tells the customer to reply to that version.
questions.zh: Proof 3 才是修正后的版本。条款要求书面批准，最新邮件也请客户回复该版本确认。

questions.prompt: Who supplied the incorrect meeting time in the first place?
questions.evidence: We sent you an outdated meeting time in our original file
questions.paraphrase: our original file → customer's source file
questions.en: The email from Garden Walks takes responsibility for the old time in its own file.
questions.zh: Garden Walks 在邮件中承认原始文件给了过时的时间。

questions.prompt: What time should appear in Proof 3?
questions.evidence: please change 8:15 to 8:45 on page two
questions.paraphrase: changed as requested → keep 8:45
questions.en: Garden Walks requested 8:45. The printer made that change, and the next correction concerns only the map key.
questions.zh: 客户要求改为 8:45，印厂已改好；下一次要修的是图例。

questions.prompt: Suppose Garden Walks then requests a new cover color of its own choosing. What would the quoted policy imply?
questions.evidence: A further round requested by the customer costs $35.
questions.paraphrase: new customer change after time correction → further round
questions.en: The customer used the included correction for its outdated time. A new cover request would be another customer round.
questions.zh: 客户因自己给错时间已用掉一轮免费修改，再主动要求换封面色将另计一轮。

documents.title: Restocking the tea shelf
documents.text:
Hi Kim,

The delivery by the back door is for the tea shelf. Please [1] the cartons before putting anything away. A list inside each carton shows which teas it contains. Match the names on that list [2] the shelf labels.

Leave the small red carton closed. [3] Its address label shows that it belongs to our next-door neighbor. A driver will collect it [4] noon today, so keep the entrance clear until then.

Jo

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: A list inside each carton
questions.paraphrase: inside → open to reach it
questions.en: Opening the cartons gives Kim access to the lists inside.
questions.zh: 清单在箱内，要先打开箱子。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [2]?
questions.evidence: the shelf labels
questions.paraphrase: match A with B → find the corresponding label
questions.en: Match one item with another is the expression for pairing items.
questions.zh: match A with B 表示把两个对应的项目配起来。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [3]?
options: It came to us by mistake.
We sell that tea by weight.
The shelf has room for it.
questions.answer: It came to us by mistake.
questions.evidence: it belongs to our next-door neighbor
questions.paraphrase: belongs next door → delivered here by mistake
questions.en: The address explains why this carton should remain closed.
questions.zh: 该箱属于邻店，说明它被错送到了这里，因而不应拆开。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [4]?
questions.evidence: noon today
questions.paraphrase: noon → a point in time
questions.en: An exact time such as noon takes at.
questions.zh: noon 是确切时点，介词用 at。

documents.title: Entrance mats
documents.text:
During wet weather we place a long mat at each entrance. Before closing time, please [1] each mat from the floor. Hang it on the rail in the washroom so both sides can dry.

The mats by the café are [2] than the others. Two people should lift each one. [3] Use the cart instead of carrying them all the way to the washroom. The cart is kept [4] the stairs and the lift, in the narrow gap.

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: Hang it on the rail
questions.paraphrase: hang the mat → lift it first
questions.en: The mats must come off the floor before staff can hang them.
questions.zh: 要把垫子挂起来，得先将它从地上提起。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [2]?
questions.evidence: Two people should lift each one.
questions.paraphrase: needs two lifters → greater weight
questions.en: Than calls for a comparative, and the next sentence points to weight.
questions.zh: than 需要比较级，两人抬表示这些垫子更重。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [3]?
options: The café will close for repairs next week.
Customers may hire umbrellas at the till.
A cart is available for the longer trip.
The rail was painted earlier this year.
questions.answer: A cart is available for the longer trip.
questions.evidence: Use the cart instead of carrying them
questions.paraphrase: the longer trip → the journey to the washroom
questions.en: Introducing the cart prepares the reader for the instruction to use it.
questions.zh: 后句要求用推车运到清洗间，因此此处先介绍可用的推车。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [4]?
questions.evidence: the stairs and the lift, in the narrow gap
questions.paraphrase: the gap separating two things → between them
questions.en: Two named objects define the sides of a single gap.
questions.zh: 楼梯和电梯是两个明确对象，推车位于两者之间。

documents.title: A mug for a full card
documents.text:
Each time you purchase a bag of beans, we will [1] one stamp to your card. When all eight spaces are full, hand the card to a member of staff and choose a mug. The mug is free, even if you do not buy anything that day.

Cards from our two branches look [2], but they have different numbers on the back. We can check the branch number if a stamp is hard to read. [3] Keep your card dry, as damaged numbers may be difficult [4].

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: one stamp to your card
questions.paraphrase: add a stamp → mark a space
questions.en: Add takes the pattern add something to something else.
questions.zh: add A to B 表示把章加盖到卡片上。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [2]?
questions.evidence: but they have different numbers
questions.paraphrase: different numbers despite similar appearance → look alike
questions.en: Look alike means resemble each other in appearance.
questions.zh: 卡面相似但背面号码各异，look alike 表示看起来相像。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [3]?
options: There are eight chairs in each branch.
A clear number identifies the card.
Our newest mug is made of recycled glass.
We roast both bags on the day of sale.
questions.answer: A clear number identifies the card.
questions.evidence: We can check the branch number if a stamp is hard to read.
questions.paraphrase: identify → recognize the issuing branch
questions.en: The number links the explanation of checking the branch to the advice about keeping the card dry.
questions.zh: 号码用来识别发卡门店，与下文保持卡片干燥相呼应。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [4]?
questions.evidence: damaged numbers may be difficult
questions.paraphrase: difficult to verify → hard to check
questions.en: Difficult takes a to-infinitive to name the action that is hard.
questions.zh: difficult 后接不定式，说明难以执行的动作。

documents.title: Head count for Thursday
documents.text:
Dear hosts,

Please send a count of your guests [1] Tuesday afternoon at the latest. The kitchen needs a full day to arrange Thursday's refreshments. Include visiting speakers in your figure, even [2] they expect to stay for just one session.

We can provide dairy-free snacks if someone asks for them. [3] Please give the number needed, without listing individual names. This information will help us prepare the correct [4] of each snack.

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: Tuesday afternoon at the latest
questions.paraphrase: at the latest → by that time
questions.en: By sets the deadline for sending the count.
questions.zh: at the latest 表示最迟时间，故用 by。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [2]?
questions.evidence: they expect to stay for just one session
questions.paraphrase: even if → regardless of a short stay
questions.en: Even if introduces a condition that does not change the request.
questions.zh: 即便讲者只参加一场，也要计入人数，even if 引导让步条件。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [3]?
options: Thursday's last session ends at five.
The kitchen will send a bill on Monday.
Ask speakers to bring their own chairs.
Tell us how many guests need that option.
questions.answer: Tell us how many guests need that option.
questions.evidence: Please give the number needed, without listing individual names.
questions.paraphrase: that option → dairy-free snacks
questions.en: The preceding sentence offers dairy-free food; the following one asks for a count.
questions.zh: 先提无乳制点心，后文要人数而不要姓名，故应询问需要这种选项的人数。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [4]?
questions.evidence: give the number needed
questions.paraphrase: quantity → amount required
questions.en: The count determines how much of each snack to prepare.
questions.zh: 人数决定各类点心应准备多少，quantity 表示数量。

documents.title: Glaze samples under two lights
documents.text:
These ceramic panels were made from the same clay. They differ only in the glaze [1] before firing. View the first set under the warm lamp and the second under the cool lamp. Each pair carries the same number.

[2] A green surface, for example, may look gray under the cooler lamp. We suggest [3] the lamps in turn before selecting a finish. Please leave the panels on their stands; this allows every visitor to compare them under [4] conditions.

questions.prompt: Which form fits [1]?
questions.evidence: before firing
questions.paraphrase: glaze that was applied → glaze applied
questions.en: The glaze receives the application. Applied is a reduced passive relative clause.
questions.zh: 釉料是被施加的，applied 相当于 that was applied。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [2]?
options: Each stand was built by the same carpenter.
The exhibition features only locally sourced clay.
Some of the samples will be sold by weight.
Light affects the color you see.
questions.answer: Light affects the color you see.
questions.evidence: A green surface, for example, may look gray
questions.paraphrase: apparent color → how the surface looks
questions.en: The green-to-gray example illustrates a general effect of lighting.
questions.zh: 绿色在不同灯下可能像灰色，是对光线影响外观颜色的举例。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [3]?
questions.evidence: We suggest
questions.paraphrase: suggest trying → recommend testing
questions.en: Suggest takes a gerund when followed directly by an action.
questions.zh: suggest 后直接接动作时用动名词 trying。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [4]?
questions.evidence: Please leave the panels on their stands
questions.paraphrase: fixed positions → consistent viewing conditions
questions.en: Keeping the panels in place makes the comparison conditions stable for different visitors.
questions.zh: 样板留在原位，可让每位观众在一致的条件下比较。

documents.title: Checking a mixed shipment
documents.text:
A shipment may contain goods for several departments. Read the destination on each carton before [1] it to a shelf. Once a carton is shelved, enter its shelf code in the delivery record.

A missing destination label does not mean that the carton should be opened. [2] The purchasing desk will trace the order using the reference printed beside the barcode. Keep the carton on the inspection bench [3] the desk confirms its destination. Following this sequence reduces the [4] of sending goods to the wrong floor.

questions.prompt: Which form fits [1]?
questions.evidence: before [1] it to a shelf
questions.paraphrase: before moving → prior to moving
questions.en: Here before is followed by an action without its own subject, so use a gerund.
questions.zh: before 后接无独立主语的动作，用动名词 moving。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [2]?
options: Report the reference with the seal intact.
List every item inside the carton by hand.
Put the items directly on the nearest empty shelf.
Ask the carrier to discard the packaging immediately.
questions.answer: Report the reference with the seal intact.
questions.evidence: using the reference printed beside the barcode
questions.paraphrase: seal intact → carton remains unopened
questions.en: The desk can trace the external reference without anyone opening the carton.
questions.zh: 条码旁的外部编号足以追查订单，所以保留封条并报告编号。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [3]?
questions.evidence: the desk confirms its destination
questions.paraphrase: until confirmation → keep waiting for confirmation
questions.en: Confirmation is the endpoint of the wait on the bench.
questions.zh: 目的地得到确认是等待状态的终点，用 until。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [4]?
questions.evidence: sending goods to the wrong floor
questions.paraphrase: risk → chance of an unwanted outcome
questions.en: Following the procedure lowers the chance of a routing mistake.
questions.zh: 执行流程能降低错送楼层的风险，选 risk。

documents.title: Extending an equipment loan
documents.text:
Members may request one extension per loan, provided [1] the item has not been reserved by another member. Submit the request while the loan is still active. The online form closes automatically at the original return time.

An extension request may remain pending while a librarian checks the reservation list. [2] The original deadline therefore remains in force until approval appears in your account. Members are responsible for [3] the status themselves. An approved extension runs for three days, [4] from the original return time.

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: the item has not been reserved
questions.paraphrase: provided that → on condition that
questions.en: Provided that introduces the condition for an extension.
questions.zh: provided that 引导续借成立的条件。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [2]?
options: Returning an item early earns a discount.
The list includes descriptions of damaged cases.
The library replaces each tool after three years.
Submitting the form does not itself grant extra time.
questions.answer: Submitting the form does not itself grant extra time.
questions.evidence: The original deadline therefore remains in force until approval
questions.paraphrase: pending request → extra time is not yet granted
questions.en: The warning explains why the first deadline still applies.
questions.zh: 申请待审核不等于已获延期，因此原截止时间仍然有效。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [3]?
questions.evidence: responsible for
questions.paraphrase: responsible for checking → must monitor
questions.en: For is a preposition here and takes the gerund checking.
questions.zh: responsible for 中 for 是介词，后接 checking。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [4]?
questions.evidence: from the original return time
questions.paraphrase: measured from → calculated starting at
questions.en: Measured describes how the three-day period is calculated.
questions.zh: measured 说明三天时长从哪个时点计算。

documents.title: Sound check protocol
documents.text:
Every act appearing in Hall Two must complete a sound check. Checks are scheduled in reverse performance order, so the final act [1] first. Equipment used by several acts may remain onstage, provided that it does not obstruct a marked exit.

The stage manager records a reference level for each microphone. [2] If a microphone is moved after the check, the marked level may no longer be [3]. Notify the manager of any such change before the audience is [4] to the hall.

questions.prompt: Which form fits [1]?
questions.evidence: the final act
questions.paraphrase: final performance slot → first rehearsal slot
questions.en: The singular subject act takes rehearses in the present tense.
questions.zh: 主语 the final act 为单数，描述固定安排用 rehearses。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [2]?
options: That reading depends partly on its position.
Some tickets include a printed schedule.
The final act sells programs at the door.
Hall Two has recently changed its name.
questions.answer: That reading depends partly on its position.
questions.evidence: If a microphone is moved after the check
questions.paraphrase: moved → change of position
questions.en: The next sentence explains what happens to the reading after a microphone moves.
questions.zh: 后句解释移动麦克风会影响读数，这里先点出位置因素。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [3]?
questions.evidence: If a microphone is moved after the check
questions.paraphrase: no longer reliable → may no longer be accurate
questions.en: Moving the microphone can make the earlier measurement inaccurate.
questions.zh: 麦克风位置改变，原来的参考值可能不再可靠。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [4]?
questions.evidence: the audience is [4] to the hall
questions.paraphrase: is admitted → is allowed in
questions.en: The audience receives permission to enter; use the passive is admitted.
questions.zh: 观众是被允许进入的一方，用被动结构 is admitted。

documents.title: Tracking reusable shipping cases
documents.text:
Each reusable case has a metal plate carrying a permanent number. The paper shipping label, by [1], changes on every journey. When reporting a lost case, quote the permanent number so we can trace the case across successive orders.

The collection screen may show an empty date field even after a case has left your premises. [2] The date appears only once the depot scans the plate. A blank field should therefore be treated as [3] rather than as proof that the case is still with you. Retain the driver's receipt until the scan has been [4].

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: a permanent number
questions.paraphrase: permanent versus changing → by contrast
questions.en: By contrast introduces the changing paper label as the opposite of the fixed plate.
questions.zh: 永久编号与每趟更换的纸标签形成对比，by contrast 是固定表达。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [2]?
options: A blank field prevents the case from moving.
The collection date is printed on every plate.
The driver can issue a new plate in the truck.
questions.evidence: only once the depot scans the plate
questions.paraphrase: departs before depot scan → two distinct events
questions.en: The case can physically leave before the depot registers its receipt.
questions.zh: 包装箱先离开客户处，再到仓库扫码，实物流转与登记并非同时。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [3]?
questions.evidence: rather than as proof that the case is still with you
questions.paraphrase: inconclusive → insufficient to establish a location
questions.en: A blank date cannot establish whether the case has been collected.
questions.zh: 日期为空不足以确定包装箱仍在客户处，inconclusive 表示没有定论。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [4]?
questions.evidence: the scan has been
questions.paraphrase: has been recorded → entered in the system
questions.en: The completed passive action takes has been recorded.
questions.zh: 扫描记录被录入系统，用现在完成时被动语态 has been recorded。

documents.title: Register of potential suppliers
documents.text:
An entry in our register signals only that a supplier is interested in future work. It neither commits the council to buying goods [1] gives the supplier priority over other bidders. A formal invitation will be issued separately if a project proceeds.

Applicants often attach complete price lists. [2] The panel considers prices only after a specification is available, when comparisons can be made on a common [3]. We therefore ask applicants to describe their capabilities at this stage and to reserve detailed quotations for any tender to which they are [4] invited.

questions.prompt: Which word fits [1]?
questions.evidence: It neither commits the council
questions.paraphrase: neither … nor → excludes two consequences
questions.en: Neither introduces the first negative alternative and pairs with nor.
questions.zh: neither 与 nor 配对，表示两种结果都不会发生。

questions.prompt: Which sentence fits [2]?
options: Such figures arrive too early to inform a decision.
Every attachment is binding for the following year.
The register is limited to suppliers of stationery.
Bidders are ranked in order of their listed prices.
questions.answer: Such figures arrive too early to inform a decision.
questions.evidence: only after a specification is available
questions.paraphrase: too early → before specifications permit comparison
questions.en: The panel needs a common specification before price figures mean enough to compare.
questions.zh: 委员会须等规格确定后才比较价格，因此现在提交完整价目表过早。

questions.prompt: Which word fits [3]?
questions.evidence: when comparisons can be made on a common
questions.paraphrase: on a common basis → under comparable criteria
questions.en: A common basis is a shared standard for comparing prices.
questions.zh: common basis 指共同的比较标准。

questions.prompt: Which form fits [4]?
questions.evidence: they are [4] invited
questions.paraphrase: formally invited → given an official invitation
questions.en: Formally is the adverb modifying invited.
questions.zh: 修饰 invited 用副词 formally，表示获得正式邀请。

documents.title: Coat counter
documents.text: Show us your coat ticket when you return. Your ticket has the same number as the hook holding your coat. If you lose it, wait until the counter closes and describe your coat to the attendant. The attendant will then check the remaining coats. The counter closes 20 minutes after the concert ends.

questions.prompt: Why does each ticket carry a number?
questions.evidence: the same number as the hook holding your coat
questions.paraphrase: identify → match ticket to hook
questions.en: The number matches the ticket with the hook where the coat hangs.
questions.zh: 编号对应挂钩，用来找到正确的外套。

questions.prompt: When can people without a ticket claim a coat?
options: At the start of the interval
questions.evidence: wait until the counter closes
questions.paraphrase: claim after closing → wait until the counter closes
questions.en: Anyone who has lost a ticket must wait until closing and describe the coat.
questions.zh: 遗失票据的人要等柜台关闭，再描述外套认领。

documents.title: Message for the morning crew
documents.text:
The water jug on the meeting table is empty. Please fill it from the kitchen tap before the visitors arrive at ten. The glasses are already on the table. After the meeting, take both the jug and the glasses to the kitchen sink. I will wash them after lunch.

Mila

questions.prompt: What should staff do before ten?
questions.evidence: fill it from the kitchen tap before the visitors arrive at ten
questions.paraphrase: before ten → before visitors arrive
questions.en: The message asks staff to fill the jug before the ten o'clock visit.
questions.zh: 访客十点到，员工需在这之前装好水。

questions.prompt: Who will wash the glasses?
questions.evidence: I will wash them after lunch.
questions.paraphrase: I → the writer, Mila
questions.en: Mila signs the message and volunteers to wash the items herself.
questions.zh: 署名的 Mila 说午餐后会亲自清洗。

documents.title: Photos in the craft room
documents.text: You may photograph the finished bowls on the central table. Please leave the flash off. The photographs on the walls belong to local artists; please do not photograph those works. At the shop beside the exit you can buy postcards showing several of the wall photographs.

questions.prompt: What may visitors photograph?
questions.evidence: photograph the finished bowls on the central table
questions.paraphrase: finished bowls → items on the central table
questions.en: Only the bowls are expressly offered for visitors to photograph.
questions.zh: 告示明确允许拍摄中央桌上的成品碗。

questions.prompt: What can visitors buy at the shop?
questions.evidence: you can buy postcards showing several of the wall photographs
questions.paraphrase: printed postcards → cards showing the photographs
questions.en: The shop sells postcards featuring some works on the walls.
questions.zh: 商店出售部分墙上摄影作品的明信片。

documents.title: Studio desk · Monday
documents.text:
Jules: Who has the key to the little supply cupboard?
Ana: I do. I'm downstairs by the vending machine. Are you coming this way?
Jules: No, a driver is waiting for me at the desk.
Ana: Stay there. I'll bring it up now.
Jules: Thanks. The driver needs a pen.

questions.prompt: Where is Ana at the start of the chat?
questions.evidence: I'm downstairs by the vending machine.
questions.paraphrase: by → next to
questions.en: Ana states her location in her first reply.
questions.zh: Ana 的第一条回复说明她在楼下自动售货机旁。

questions.prompt: What does “Stay there” suggest?
options: The driver should come back later.
questions.evidence: I'll bring it up now.
questions.paraphrase: bring it up → take the key to Jules
questions.en: Ana tells Jules to wait because she will bring the key upstairs herself.
questions.zh: Ana 自己会上楼送钥匙，因此让 Jules 留在原处。

documents.title: A smaller bag for shorter trips
documents.text: Our Weekender bag holds a change of clothes and a pair of shoes. Each bag comes with a removable shoulder strap. Choose black or blue at either branch. Green bags are available only from the website. Orders placed online by noon qualify for same-day dispatch; delivery time depends on your address.

questions.prompt: Which color requires an online order?
questions.evidence: Green bags are available only from the website.
questions.paraphrase: only from the website → must order online
questions.en: The shop branches carry black and blue, while green is web-only.
questions.zh: 两家门店售黑蓝两色，绿色只在网上出售。

questions.prompt: What is included with each bag?
questions.evidence: comes with a removable shoulder strap
questions.paraphrase: included → comes with
questions.en: A strap accompanies the bag and can be removed.
questions.zh: 每个包都配有可拆卸肩带。

documents.title: Subject: Vase collection
documents.text:
Dear Ms. Park,

The flowers will reach your office on Friday morning. The glass vase is ours. When the flowers are no longer on display, call the number on the tag. We will send someone to pick up the empty vase. The collection fee is already included in your order.

Lena, Reed Flowers

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?
questions.evidence: We will send someone to pick up the empty vase.
questions.paraphrase: vase return → pickup of the empty vase
questions.en: The message explains who owns the vase and how the customer can return it.
questions.zh: 邮件主要说明花瓶的所有权与归还方式。

questions.prompt: What should Ms. Park do after the display ends?
options: Call the number on the tag.
Pay the driver a second fee.
Take the vase to the store.
questions.answer: Call the number on the tag.
questions.evidence: call the number on the tag
questions.paraphrase: after the display ends → when flowers are no longer on display
questions.en: Calling the tagged number arranges the collection.
questions.zh: 花不再展出后，应打标签上的电话安排取回。

documents.title: Equipment desk reply
documents.text: Your request for a small mixer has been accepted. Collect it from the equipment desk on Tuesday. A metal bowl comes with the mixer. Bring the mixer and bowl back together on Friday before four. Wipe the bowl dry before you pack it. There is no charge for this loan.

questions.prompt: What must be returned with the mixer?
questions.evidence: Bring the mixer and bowl back together
questions.paraphrase: with the mixer → together
questions.en: The reply tells the borrower to bring the bowl back with the mixer.
questions.zh: 搅拌器和配套金属碗要一起归还。

questions.prompt: Which detail is NOT mentioned?
questions.evidence: Your request for a small mixer has been accepted.
questions.paraphrase: small → size, not color
questions.en: The reply gives the days, deadline and fee and identifies the size, but never specifies a color.
questions.zh: 正文给出领取日、截止时间与费用，只提到尺寸，未说明颜色。

documents.title: Subject: Ten minutes at the desk
documents.text:
We will meet at the dispatch desk at 8:40 tomorrow. Please leave your parcel list there this evening; I want to check it before we meet. Our usual meeting room is booked for new-staff training. We will finish by 8:50, in time for the vans to leave at nine.

Morgan

questions.prompt: Why was the dispatch desk chosen?
questions.evidence: Our usual meeting room is booked for new-staff training.
questions.paraphrase: booked → already reserved
questions.en: Training will occupy the normal meeting room.
questions.zh: 原会议室已被新人培训预订，因此改在调度台碰面。

questions.prompt: When does Morgan want the parcel list?
questions.evidence: leave your parcel list there this evening
questions.paraphrase: there → the dispatch desk
questions.en: Morgan wants time to check the list before the morning meeting.
questions.zh: Morgan 想在早会前检查清单，所以要求今晚留下。

documents.title: Requesting a receipt copy
documents.text:
Enter the date shown on your bank statement and the amount charged.
We use these details to locate the sale.

If you bought several items in one transaction, enter the total rather than a price for each item. A copy will be emailed within two working days. This service covers purchases made in our stores only.

questions.prompt: The word “locate” in paragraph 1, line 2, is closest in meaning to which option?
questions.evidence: locate the sale
questions.paraphrase: locate a sale → find its record
questions.en: Staff use the date and amount to find a particular sale in their records.
questions.zh: 工作人员用日期和金额查到相应的销售记录，locate 在此为“找到”。

questions.prompt: Which purchase qualifies for this service?
questions.evidence: covers purchases made in our stores only
questions.paraphrase: in-store → made in our stores
questions.en: The final sentence limits the service to store purchases.
questions.zh: 末句说明服务仅适用于门店购买。

documents.title: Uniform fitting on Wednesday
documents.text: A tailor will visit the staff room from noon until three. You can try on sample jackets there and record the size you want. Please wear the shirt you normally wear at work so the tailor can check the fit. The samples must stay in the staff room; the jackets you order will arrive next month.

questions.prompt: Why should staff wear their usual work shirts?
questions.evidence: so the tailor can check the fit
questions.paraphrase: check the fit → see how the jacket sits over clothing
questions.en: Wearing the usual shirt lets the tailor assess the jacket in its normal setting.
questions.zh: 穿日常工作衬衫有助于检查外套平时穿着时是否合身。

questions.prompt: Which statement is true?
options: Samples stay in the staff room.
questions.answer: Samples stay in the staff room.
questions.evidence: The samples must stay in the staff room
questions.paraphrase: stay → remain on site
questions.en: The jackets on display are samples; actual orders arrive next month.
questions.zh: 试穿样衣留在员工休息室，订购的外套下月到。

documents.title: Museum desk · afternoon
documents.text:
Nell: I tested guide 14. The screen lights up, but the headphones are silent.
Omar: Try the headphones from guide 15.
Nell: I can hear the tour now.
Omar: Then leave 14 on the counter with the working pair. Put the silent pair in the repair tray.
Nell: Done. I will fetch another pair for 15.

questions.prompt: What does Nell mean by “I can hear the tour now”?
questions.evidence: Try the headphones from guide 15.
questions.paraphrase: other headphones → the pair from guide 15
questions.en: Nell reports success immediately after trying the second pair.
questions.zh: Nell 是在换上 15 号机的耳机后听到了讲解，说明那副耳机正常。

questions.prompt: What will Nell do next?
options: Take the tray to the till.
questions.evidence: I will fetch another pair for 15.
questions.paraphrase: fetch → go and get
questions.en: Nell's last message states her next action.
questions.zh: 末句说明她接下来会为 15 号导览机再取一副耳机。

documents.title: Move-day box labels
documents.text: Write a room number on the top of every box. Files that staff will need on the first morning should go into boxes with a yellow strip. We will open those first. Pack framed pictures separately and write GLASS on those boxes. A box may carry both a room number and a handling instruction.

questions.prompt: What does a yellow strip mean?
questions.evidence: We will open those first.
questions.paraphrase: those → yellow-strip boxes
questions.en: Files needed on the first morning go into boxes marked to be opened first.
questions.zh: 黄条箱放第一天早上要用的文件，需要先打开。

questions.prompt: Which instruction applies to every box?
questions.evidence: Write a room number on the top of every box.
questions.paraphrase: every box → all packed boxes
questions.en: Room numbers go on all boxes, regardless of content.
questions.zh: 不论箱内装什么，所有箱顶都须标房间号。

documents.title: Ridge Café · Breakfast offer
documents.text: Present this card before ordering at the counter to receive a free small juice with any hot breakfast. One card per breakfast. The offer is available on weekdays until 10:30 a.m. It cannot be used with table service. The juice may be taken away in a paper cup.

questions.prompt: Which customer can use the card?
options: A weekday counter customer at noon
A weekday table customer at ten
A Sunday counter customer at eight
A weekday counter customer at nine
questions.answer: A weekday counter customer at nine
questions.evidence: on weekdays until 10:30 a.m.
questions.paraphrase: weekday counter customer at nine → within the offer period and service
questions.en: The customer must order a hot breakfast at the counter on a weekday before the cutoff.
questions.zh: 要在工作日上午截止前于柜台点热早餐，只有工作日九点的柜台顾客符合。

questions.prompt: What does the offer provide?
questions.evidence: a free small juice with any hot breakfast
questions.paraphrase: provide → include at no extra cost
questions.en: The card adds a free small juice to a hot breakfast purchase.
questions.zh: 优惠券附送的是小杯果汁。

documents.title: A new place for the reading bench
documents.text: The long bench near the newspaper stand will move to the window on Friday. [1] At its present location, the bench blocks a cupboard whenever someone sits at the left end. [2] Staff need to open that cupboard for a second delivery each afternoon. [3] An outlet by the new spot will also let visitors charge a phone while reading. [4] The newspaper stand itself will stay where it is.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? “Moving the bench will leave the cupboard clear for that afternoon delivery.”
questions.evidence: a second delivery each afternoon
questions.paraphrase: open the cupboard for a second delivery → leave the cupboard clear for that delivery
questions.en: Only at [3] has the afternoon delivery just been introduced. The following sentence adds a second advantage of moving the bench.
questions.zh: 只有 [3] 紧接刚刚提到的下午送货，that afternoon delivery 有明确指代；下一句再用 also 补充搬移长椅的另一项好处。

questions.prompt: Which item will remain in its current position?
questions.evidence: The newspaper stand itself will stay where it is.
questions.paraphrase: remain in its current position → stay where it is
questions.en: The final sentence explicitly leaves the stand in place.
questions.zh: 末句明确指出报刊架不会移动。

documents.title: Feedback on direction signs
documents.text:
The new entrance sign is easy to spot from the street. Inside, however, the arrow for the upstairs office points toward a closed door. [1] I tried the handle twice before a cleaner showed me the stairs behind the reception counter. [2] I suggest adding the word “stairs” and turning the arrow to the right. [3] New visitors could then follow the sign without asking for help. [4]

M. Davis

questions.prompt: Why did Davis try the door handle?
options: An arrow pointed to the door.
questions.answer: An arrow pointed to the door.
questions.evidence: the arrow for the upstairs office points toward a closed door
questions.paraphrase: misleading arrow → reason for trying the door
questions.en: The existing arrow seems to direct a visitor toward the closed door.
questions.zh: 指示上楼的箭头指向关着的门，导致 Davis 试着开门。

questions.prompt: Where does “With those two changes, the sign would name the route and point toward it.” fit best?
questions.evidence: adding the word “stairs” and turning the arrow to the right
questions.paraphrase: those two changes → adding a word and rotating the arrow
questions.en: The proposed changes are introduced together immediately before [3]. The word then in the next sentence links them to a benefit for visitors.
questions.zh: [3] 前刚说加 stairs 和右转箭头两项修改，those two changes 紧接它们，下一句说明访客会怎样受益。

documents.title: Viewing the training calendar
documents.text: The calendar initially lists every session, including those that are full. Select “Open seats” to show only sessions that can still accept bookings. A gray date indicates a session that has ended, not a full session. To read the notes from an earlier workshop, turn off the filter and select its gray date. Notes are available even to staff who did not attend.

questions.prompt: What should staff do to see a past workshop's notes?
questions.evidence: turn off the filter and select its gray date
questions.paraphrase: remove the filter → turn it off
questions.en: Past workshops can be found by clearing the open-seat filter and selecting a gray date.
questions.zh: 要看过往记录，先关掉空位筛选，再选灰色日期。

questions.prompt: Which detail is NOT stated?
questions.evidence: Notes are available even to staff who did not attend.
questions.paraphrase: access described → retention period unspecified
questions.en: The notice says who may read notes and how to find them, but gives no retention period.
questions.zh: 说明给出了查找方法与访问权限，未交代笔记保留多久。

documents.title: A check on replacement blades
documents.text: A carton contains ten sealed packs of blades. Take one pack from each carton for testing and leave the other nine sealed. If the tested pack passes, stamp the carton with the date. If it fails, move the entire carton to the inspection bay. Do not stamp it. The date stamp allows warehouse staff to distinguish approved stock from cartons still awaiting a test.

questions.prompt: What happens after a pack fails the test?
options: Its blades are mixed with new ones.
Its nine other packs are sold first.
Its carton receives a date stamp.
questions.evidence: move the entire carton to the inspection bay
questions.paraphrase: entire carton → failed pack and remaining packs
questions.en: Failure sends the whole carton, not just the tested pack, to the inspection bay.
questions.zh: 样包未通过时，整箱都要移到检查区。

questions.prompt: In the last sentence, “distinguish” most nearly means what?
questions.evidence: distinguish approved stock from cartons still awaiting a test
questions.paraphrase: distinguish A from B → tell A and B apart
questions.en: The stamp lets staff recognize which cartons have passed.
questions.zh: 日期戳让员工分辨哪些箱子已获通过。

documents.title: Small garden awards
documents.text: Can two teams apply for one award? Yes, provided they name one contact person. We communicate with that person throughout the project. Awards cover seeds and hand tools. Land rental is outside the scheme. You may apply before your site is ready, but you must include the landowner's written permission with the form. Payment is made after a successful applicant submits receipts.

questions.prompt: Which cost is outside the award?
questions.evidence: Land rental is outside the scheme.
questions.paraphrase: outside → excluded from coverage
questions.en: The rules include seeds and tools but exclude land rental.
questions.zh: 规则包含种子与手工具费用，明确排除地租。

questions.prompt: What must a joint application include?
options: A separate award for each team
questions.evidence: provided they name one contact person
questions.paraphrase: joint application → two teams applying together
questions.en: Teams may apply together if they designate one person for communications.
questions.zh: 两队共同申请的条件是指定一名联系人。

documents.title: Packing trial, batch 2
documents.text: We sent three identical cups in each box. For the first ten boxes, we used loose paper as padding; for the next ten, we used folded paper sleeves. Two cups broke in the loose-paper boxes. None broke in the sleeve boxes. However, packing a sleeve box took four minutes longer. A second trial will test whether preparing sleeves the day before reduces packing time.

questions.prompt: What is one drawback of the sleeves?
options: They cannot be made in advance.
questions.evidence: packing a sleeve box took four minutes longer
questions.paraphrase: drawback → extra packing time
questions.en: The sleeves protected the cups, but packing took longer.
questions.zh: 纸套虽保护了杯子，打包却耗时更长。

questions.prompt: What will the next trial examine?
options: Using fewer cups in each box
Changing the size of the cups
questions.evidence: preparing sleeves the day before reduces packing time
questions.paraphrase: earlier → the day before
questions.en: The trial will change when sleeves are prepared and check the effect on packing time.
questions.zh: 下一轮会提前一天准备纸套，观察是否能缩短打包时间。

documents.title: When a collection counts as attempted
documents.text: A collection counts as attempted only if the driver reaches the listed address during the agreed window and finds no cases ready. We then charge a second-trip fee for a new booking. If the driver arrives after the window, we rearrange the visit without a fee, even if no cases are ready on arrival. A photograph of the stop records the time and address; it does not show whether the cases were ready.

questions.prompt: Which visit can lead to a second-trip fee?
options: On time, with no cases ready
questions.answer: On time, with no cases ready
questions.evidence: during the agreed window and finds no cases ready
questions.paraphrase: on time plus no cases → qualifying attempt
questions.en: Both conditions in the first sentence must apply before the fee is charged.
questions.zh: 只有按时到达且箱子未备好同时成立，才会收二次上门费。

questions.prompt: What can the photograph establish?
questions.evidence: records the time and address
questions.paraphrase: when → recorded time
questions.en: The image records time and address but does not verify the readiness of cases.
questions.zh: 照片记录时间、地址，无法证明箱子是否准备好。

documents.title: Courtyard options
documents.text: Twenty tenants voted for benches and twelve for planters. The committee supported the more popular choice, subject to an access check. The marked fire lane must remain clear at all times. If a bench cannot fit outside the lane, the committee will reconsider planters, which can stand on the narrow ledge. No purchase order has been issued; the access check is booked for Friday.

questions.prompt: What remains uncertain?
options: When the access check will occur
Whether a bench can fit safely
questions.answer: Whether a bench can fit safely
questions.evidence: subject to an access check
questions.paraphrase: conditional support → final feasibility unknown
questions.en: Benches won the vote, but the access check must establish whether there is enough space.
questions.zh: 长椅票数领先，最终能否放下还要等通行检查。

questions.prompt: In the third sentence, what does “clear” mean?
questions.evidence: fire lane must remain clear
questions.paraphrase: clear lane → unobstructed passage
questions.en: A fire lane must be free of objects that block movement.
questions.zh: 消防通道必须保持畅通，此处 clear 指没有障碍物。

documents.title: Requesting archived minutes
documents.text: Our printed index gives each folder a shelf code. To request a folder, enter that code exactly as printed, including the final letter. Two folders can have the same number but different letters. Requests received by Thursday noon are prepared for Friday viewing. Later requests go into the following week's batch. A booking lets you view the folder on site; permission to copy its contents must be requested separately.

questions.prompt: Why must a requester enter the final letter?
questions.evidence: Two folders can have the same number but different letters.
questions.paraphrase: may be shared → can be the same
questions.en: The letter distinguishes folders that share the numeric part of a code.
questions.zh: 不同文件夹可能号码相同，末尾字母可区分它们。

questions.prompt: What does an ordinary booking allow?
options: Photocopying the entire folder in the reading room
questions.evidence: lets you view the folder on site
questions.paraphrase: ordinary booking → permission to view
questions.en: The viewing booking grants access on site. Copying requires further permission.
questions.zh: 常规预约只允许现场查阅，复制须另申请。

documents.title: Response to a dual payment
documents.text: Our system shows a deposit and a balance payment, both charged to the same card. We will refund only the deposit, since a voucher covered that portion of the order. The balance was due in cash or by card. Your bank may list the refund as a separate credit rather than deleting the original deposit entry. If both the original charge and a matching credit appear, you have already received the refund.

questions.prompt: What explains the refund?
questions.evidence: a voucher covered that portion of the order
questions.paraphrase: that portion → the deposit
questions.en: The voucher covers the deposit portion, so that earlier card charge is returned.
questions.zh: 代金券覆盖定金部分，因此退还该笔刷卡金额。

questions.prompt: In the fourth sentence, “credit” refers to what?
questions.evidence: list the refund as a separate credit
questions.paraphrase: credit → money added back to the account
questions.en: Here a credit is an entry returning money to the card account.
questions.zh: 此处 credit 指把退款记回卡账户的贷记金额。

documents.title: Provisional allocations
documents.text:
A provisional allocation reserves seats for a group until its stated deadline. During that period the organizer can reduce the quantity without charge. After confirmation, however, each reduction is treated as a cancellation for the seats released. A reduction made before confirmation does not alter the deadline for the remaining seats. Unconfirmed seats lapse automatically at that deadline even if the group has already reduced its order.
For example, an organizer holding forty seats until Friday can release ten on Wednesday. The remaining thirty still need confirmation by Friday. The sales office will answer questions about the booking during that interval, but an inquiry by itself does not count as confirmation.

questions.prompt: What follows an early reduction of an unconfirmed allocation?
options: All seats go back on sale.
questions.evidence: does not alter the deadline for the remaining seats
questions.paraphrase: does not alter → leaves unchanged
questions.en: A smaller provisional allocation retains its existing confirmation deadline.
questions.zh: 尚未确认前减少数量，不会改变剩余座位的确认期限。

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT true?
options: An organizer may trim a provisional order.
Reducing an order renews its deadline.
questions.answer: Reducing an order renews its deadline.
questions.evidence: does not alter the deadline
questions.paraphrase: renew → extend, contrary to the explicit rule
questions.en: The text explicitly says an early reduction leaves the deadline unchanged.
questions.zh: 正文明确说提前减少座位不改变截止时间，所以声称可续期的选项错误。

documents.title: Reply from the market coordinator
documents.text: Your application arrived one day before that of Hazel Press. Within a product category we normally offer a vacant stall to the earliest applicant. The stall now open, however, is wired for refrigerated goods and is reserved for food sellers. Both your stationery business and Hazel Press remain on the paper-goods list. If a paper-goods stall opens, your earlier application date will still count.

questions.prompt: Why has the writer not offered the available stall to the recipient?
options: It is reserved for food sales.
questions.answer: It is reserved for food sales.
questions.evidence: reserved for food sellers
questions.paraphrase: reserved → restricted to one category
questions.en: Priority by date applies within a category, and the current vacancy is for food sellers.
questions.zh: 日期优先只在同类内适用，当前空位专供食品摊商。

questions.prompt: What is implied about Hazel Press?
options: It can use the refrigerated stall if it applies today.
It will take the next opening in every category.
It would follow the recipient for a paper-goods opening.
It was given priority because it sells stationery.
questions.answer: It would follow the recipient for a paper-goods opening.
questions.evidence: your earlier application date will still count
questions.paraphrase: earlier application → earlier place within the same category
questions.en: Both applicants share a list; the recipient applied first, which establishes relative priority.
questions.zh: 两家都在纸制品名单，收件人先申请，所以同类空位会先轮到收件人。

documents.title: Separating service and equipment charges
documents.text:
A migration allowance covers documented technician time but excludes equipment, even when the same contractor supplies both. An invoice that bundles the charges must be supported by a breakdown from the contractor. Staff estimates cannot establish the split. Once an acceptable breakdown is received, finance will assess the technician portion; receiving it does not establish that all hours qualify under the project dates.
If a single invoice spans two project periods, attach a dated work log as well as the breakdown. The breakdown identifies what the contractor supplied. The log identifies when the technician performed each task. A missing log can delay the decision even when the labor and equipment figures are perfectly clear.

questions.prompt: Why might finance pay less than the technician amount on an itemized bill?
options: All technician costs must be paid by the contractor.
Some hours may fall outside the project dates.
questions.answer: Some hours may fall outside the project dates.
questions.evidence: does not establish that all hours qualify under the project dates
questions.paraphrase: itemization → identifies labor but does not confirm date eligibility
questions.en: Breaking out labor costs addresses classification. The dates of those hours still affect eligibility.
questions.zh: 费用明细解决的是分类问题，工时是否在项目期限内仍要审核。

questions.prompt: What does “the split” in the third sentence refer to?
options: The difference between two contractors' quotes
The interval between two project dates
The division of hours among finance staff
The division between labor and equipment
questions.answer: The division between labor and equipment
questions.evidence: bundles the charges must be supported by a breakdown
questions.paraphrase: the split → allocation of a bundled price
questions.en: The preceding sentence requires bundled service and equipment charges to be separated.
questions.zh: 前一句要求拆分服务费与设备费，the split 就是这种分摊。

documents.title: Early access to evaluation units
documents.text:
An evaluation unit may be supplied before the full manual is available if the receiving team signs the early-access form. The form acknowledges the missing manual and nothing further. In particular, acceptance of delivery does not start the warranty period. That period begins when the supplier issues written confirmation that the unit is ready for ordinary use. A team can therefore hold a unit for several days without using up any warranty time.
A delivery slip records the date on which the receiving team took possession. The supplier may attach that slip to the later readiness notice for identification, but the earlier date does not replace the date of the notice. Please file both records so their different purposes remain clear.

questions.prompt: Which event starts the warranty?
options: A team member's first test run
questions.evidence: when the supplier issues written confirmation
questions.paraphrase: readiness confirmed in writing → warranty begins
questions.en: The specified trigger is the supplier's notice that ordinary use can begin.
questions.zh: 触发质保的是供应商出具书面就绪确认。

questions.prompt: What is the main function of the signed form?
questions.evidence: acknowledges the missing manual and nothing further
questions.paraphrase: acknowledge → formally recognize
questions.en: The form records awareness of the missing documentation without changing warranty timing.
questions.zh: 该表仅证明收件方知悉手册尚未提供。

documents.title: Cedar Keyrings · standard prices
documents.text: Plain metal ring: $2 each. Ring with a printed name: $3 each. Printing takes three working days from payment. Plain rings can be collected on the day of payment. Orders of ten or more rings receive a free cloth bag. All collections are at the market desk.

documents.title: To: Cedar Keyrings · Order question
documents.text:
I need eight rings for a welcome pack. The packs leave this afternoon, so I will take plain rings and pay when I arrive today. I already have a bag for carrying them. Could you put my order under the name Sol Marsh?

Sol

questions.prompt: Why has Sol chosen plain rings?
questions.evidence: The packs leave this afternoon
questions.paraphrase: same-day departure → same-day collection needed
questions.en: Sol needs them this afternoon. The quote allows immediate collection of plain rings, while printing takes three working days.
questions.zh: 欢迎包下午发走，素环当天可取，印名字则需三个工作日。

questions.prompt: What will Sol pay for the rings?
questions.evidence: Plain metal ring: $2 each.
questions.paraphrase: eight plain rings × $2 → $16
questions.en: The email orders eight plain rings; the quote charges $2 each.
questions.zh: 邮件订八个素环，报价每个两美元，合计十六美元。

questions.prompt: Where will Sol pick up the order?
questions.evidence: All collections are at the market desk.
questions.paraphrase: pick up → collect
questions.en: The quote directs all customers to the market desk for collection.
questions.zh: 报价说明所有订单都到集市柜台领取。

questions.prompt: Why does this order miss the bag offer?
options: The pack is assembled off site.
It has fewer than ten rings.
questions.answer: It has fewer than ten rings.
questions.evidence: Orders of ten or more rings receive a free cloth bag.
questions.paraphrase: eight is below ten → no free bag
questions.en: The email requests eight units, two below the quote's minimum for the gift.
questions.zh: 索要八个，比赠袋门槛十个少两个。

questions.prompt: What is Sol asking Cedar to record?
questions.evidence: put my order under the name Sol Marsh
questions.paraphrase: under the name → identify an order for pickup
questions.en: Sol wants the order identified by name when collecting it.
questions.zh: Sol 希望用自己的姓名登记，便于领取。

documents.title: Portable ovens · one-day hire
documents.text: Small oven: $28; bakes two trays at once. Large oven: $42; bakes four trays at once. Each oven comes with enough trays to fill it. A heatproof stand costs an extra $6. Collect equipment at the workshop after 8 a.m.; return by 6 p.m. the same day.

documents.title: Workshop booking · Hall team
documents.text:
We need to bake four trays in a single batch before the morning break. Our table has a plastic top, so please add a heatproof stand. I'll collect the equipment at 8:30 and take it back after lunch. We have already ordered the ingredients from another supplier.

Amir

questions.prompt: Which oven meets the team's batch requirement?
questions.evidence: four trays in a single batch
questions.paraphrase: single batch → bake all four at once
questions.en: The large model takes four trays at once; the small model takes only two.
questions.zh: 要一次烤四盘，只有大烤箱满足。

questions.prompt: What is the hire total for one suitable oven and the requested extra?
questions.evidence: A heatproof stand costs an extra $6.
questions.paraphrase: large oven plus stand → $42 + $6
questions.en: The four-tray model costs $42 and the requested stand adds $6.
questions.zh: 四盘规格租金 42 美元，另需隔热架 6 美元，共 48 美元。

questions.prompt: Why does Amir request a stand?
options: The oven must travel on a cart.
The table has a plastic top.
questions.answer: The table has a plastic top.
questions.evidence: Our table has a plastic top
questions.paraphrase: heatproof stand → protects the work surface
questions.en: Amir directly links the plastic surface to the need for a heatproof stand.
questions.zh: Amir 说明桌面为塑料，因此要加隔热架。

questions.prompt: Which item has already been arranged separately?
questions.evidence: ordered the ingredients from another supplier
questions.paraphrase: arranged separately → ordered elsewhere
questions.en: The team obtained ingredients from another supplier.
questions.zh: 食材已经向另一供应商订购。

questions.prompt: What is true about the proposed collection time?
questions.evidence: Collect equipment at the workshop after 8 a.m.
questions.paraphrase: 8:30 pickup → later than 8:00
questions.en: The quote permits pickup after eight; Amir proposes 8:30.
questions.zh: 价目表允许八点以后领取，Amir 提出的八点半符合。

documents.title: Conference shuttle · departures from hotel
documents.text: Both blue buses run to Main Hall from Bay A. Both gold departures use Bay B for the Annex. Each journey takes fifteen minutes. Please arrive five minutes before departure. The blue and gold routes have separate tickets.

documents.title: Morning update from the hotel
documents.text: Work on the pavement outside Bay A will affect only today's second blue departure. That bus will pick up at Bay C instead. The driver will follow the printed timetable. Staff at the hotel desk can exchange unused tickets until a bus departs.

questions.prompt: Which departure uses Bay C?
questions.evidence: only today's second blue departure
questions.paraphrase: second blue departure → 08:40
questions.en: The timetable lists blue buses at 08:00 and 08:40; the notice moves only the second.
questions.zh: 蓝线两班分别为 8:00 与 8:40，只有第二班改站。

questions.prompt: At what time should a passenger for the relocated bus be at its bay?
questions.evidence: Please arrive five minutes before departure.
questions.paraphrase: five minutes before 08:40 → 08:35
questions.en: The affected departure stays at 08:40. The timetable requests arrival five minutes early.
questions.zh: 改站班次仍是 8:40 发车，要提前五分钟到，即 8:35。

questions.prompt: Where should a passenger go for the 09:00 service?
questions.evidence: Both gold departures use Bay B for the Annex.
questions.paraphrase: gold route → unaffected bay
questions.en: The timetable shows that 09:00 is a gold departure from B. The update affects only one blue departure.
questions.zh: 改站通知只涉及蓝线，9:00 金线仍在 B 站。

questions.prompt: What is unchanged for the affected bus?
options: The pavement at its usual bay
questions.evidence: driver will follow the printed timetable
questions.paraphrase: follow the timetable → keep the listed time
questions.en: The notice explicitly keeps the schedule while changing the pickup bay.
