questions.zh: 通知明确只改乘车处，发车仍按原时刻表。

questions.prompt: What would a holder of an unused gold ticket need in order to take a blue bus?
questions.evidence: blue and gold routes have separate tickets
questions.paraphrase: separate tickets → change the ticket for another route
questions.en: The routes require different tickets. The desk allows unused tickets to be exchanged before departure.
questions.zh: 两条路线票种不同，出发前可在酒店柜台换未使用的票。

documents.title: Oriel Works · order 63
documents.text: Please send twelve copper sheets, each 2 mm thick. We can accept two bundles of six or three bundles of four. Attach a thickness reading to each bundle. Our gate accepts deliveries until 16:30 on weekdays. Orders are signed for only after the readings have been checked.

documents.title: Friday, 16:10 · incoming driver
documents.text: I have three bundles on the truck. Each contains four sheets and has its reading attached. One reading shows 1.5 mm; the other two show 2 mm. I will reach your gate at 16:25. Shall I hold the thinner bundle on the truck while your receiver checks the rest? The individual readings are copied below in loading order.

questions.prompt: How many sheets meet the stated thickness according to the readings?
questions.evidence: the other two show 2 mm.
questions.paraphrase: two bundles of four → eight suitable sheets
questions.en: Two bundles meet 2 mm, and each contains four sheets.
questions.zh: 两捆厚度合格，每捆四张，共八张。

questions.prompt: Which order requirement is already met for every bundle?
questions.evidence: Each contains four sheets and has its reading attached.
questions.paraphrase: attach a reading → measurement supplied
questions.en: The order requests a thickness reading on every bundle; the driver confirms all three have one.
questions.zh: 三捆都有读数，满足每捆必须附测量值的要求。

questions.prompt: Which bundle should the receiver keep apart because it misses the thickness requirement?
questions.evidence: One reading shows 1.5 mm
questions.paraphrase: middle bundle at 1.5 mm → below the 2 mm specification
questions.en: The table identifies the middle bundle as 1.5 mm. The purchase order specifies 2 mm.
questions.zh: 表格中间那捆是 1.5 毫米，未达到订单要求的 2 毫米。

questions.prompt: Which action is required before signing for the order?
questions.evidence: signed for only after the readings have been checked
questions.paraphrase: before signing → after checking
questions.en: The order explicitly makes the measurement check a condition of signing.
questions.zh: 订单说明核查测量值后才签收。

questions.prompt: If the driver arrives as predicted, how much time remains before the gate stops accepting deliveries?
questions.evidence: until 16:30 on weekdays
questions.paraphrase: 16:25 to 16:30 → five minutes
questions.en: Friday is a weekday. The expected arrival is 16:25, five minutes before the cutoff.
questions.zh: 周五截止 16:30，预计 16:25 到达，相差五分钟。

documents.title: Clear Line · caption services
documents.text: Base captions cost $4 per finished minute of video. A transcript in a separate file costs $12 per project. Correcting an error made by our captioner is included. Changes to words already spoken correctly and captioned accurately are charged at $8 per request.

documents.title: From: Sera Lin · revised training clip
documents.text: The finished clip is six minutes long. We need captions and a separate transcript. Our trainer says “west door” at 02:10 and your captions currently read “west door.” Since that entrance has been renamed, please show “garden door” instead. We have no other changes to request.

questions.prompt: Which item attracts the $8 charge?
questions.evidence: your captions currently read “west door.”
questions.paraphrase: matches the spoken words → customer-requested change
questions.en: The existing caption accurately matches the trainer. The requested renaming is therefore a charged change.
questions.zh: 现有字幕忠实反映原话，客户因改名要求换词，按规则另收费。

questions.prompt: What is the full quoted cost of the requested work?
questions.evidence: The finished clip is six minutes long.
questions.en: Six minutes of captions cost $24. Add the $12 transcript and one $8 wording change.
questions.zh: 字幕 6×4=24 美元，加文本 12 与改词 8，共 44。

questions.prompt: What would be included without the change charge?
options: Extending the video by a minute
questions.evidence: Correcting an error made by our captioner is included.
questions.paraphrase: included → covered by the base service
questions.en: The quote covers a correction when the captioner caused the mistake.
questions.zh: 报价写明，字幕人员自身造成的错误可免费修正。

questions.prompt: What does Sera want in a separate file?
questions.evidence: a separate transcript
questions.paraphrase: transcript → written record of the speech
questions.en: Sera asks for a written transcript as a separate deliverable.
questions.zh: Sera 除字幕外，还要一份独立的文字稿。

questions.prompt: Why has Sera proposed the word “garden”?
options: The west door is shown at its old size.
The clip was filmed in a garden.
questions.evidence: that entrance has been renamed
questions.paraphrase: new name → revised caption wording
questions.en: The requested change reflects the entrance's new name.
questions.zh: 更改字幕是为了反映入口的新名称。

documents.title: Mere House · conference rooms
documents.text:
Pay a $60 deposit per booking. Up to seven days before the event, a booking may be transferred once to a different room on the same date without losing the deposit. After that point any room change counts as a new booking. The original deposit is then forfeited. A deposit is credited toward the room fee only if the corresponding booking goes ahead.
To keep a transfer within the original booking, the organizer must also give the original booking number. An agent can change the room on the existing receipt only while the transfer window is open. After that, even an identical event name and date will not link the two deposits.

documents.title: From: L. Vale · three days before the event
documents.text: We reserved Room Ash for Friday and paid the deposit. We now need Room Elm on the same Friday because Ash has no projection screen. Elm is available at $200, and we understand a fresh $60 deposit is required. We will proceed with Elm and cancel Ash. Please tell us the remaining room balance due for Elm after that fresh deposit.

questions.prompt: What will remain payable for Elm after the new deposit?
questions.evidence: Elm is available at $200
questions.paraphrase: Elm fee less its own deposit → $140
questions.en: Only Elm's $60 deposit applies to its $200 fee. Ash's deposit is forfeited.
questions.zh: Elm 费用 200，只扣该预订的新押金 60，余 140。

questions.prompt: Why cannot Ash's deposit transfer to Elm?
options: Elm is on a different date.
questions.evidence: After that point any room change counts as a new booking.
questions.paraphrase: three days before → inside the seven-day cutoff
questions.en: The request is three days before the event; the transfer privilege ends seven days before it.
questions.zh: 距活动仅三天，已过提前七天的免损转移期限。

questions.prompt: Which feature explains the switch?
questions.evidence: because Ash has no projection screen
questions.paraphrase: needs a screen → Ash is unsuitable
questions.en: The email gives Ash's lack of a screen as the reason.
questions.zh: 邮件说 Ash 没有投影幕，因而需换房。

questions.prompt: In the policy, “forfeited” most nearly means what?
questions.evidence: The original deposit is then forfeited.
questions.paraphrase: forfeited → given up after a late change
questions.en: The original deposit can no longer be used or credited after a late room change.
questions.zh: 在此 forfeited 指押金因逾期换房而被没收、不能再抵扣。

questions.prompt: What is the group's total outlay across both bookings if Elm goes ahead?
questions.evidence: A deposit is credited toward the room fee only if the corresponding booking goes ahead.
questions.paraphrase: lost $60 plus Elm fee of $200 → $260
questions.en: The group pays Elm's $200 room fee in total and loses the original $60 for Ash.
questions.zh: Elm 总房费为 200，另损失 Ash 的 60 押金，相关总支出为 260。

documents.title: Rill Costumes · curtain panels
documents.text: Order 90 meters of plum fabric at $6 per meter. We can use lengths of 15 meters or more. Please send the full quantity by Thursday noon. Each of our six curtains uses one continuous 15-meter panel; joining shorter lengths would leave a visible seam.

documents.title: Thursday 09:30 · shipment 48
documents.text: Plum fabric: five rolls of 15 meters each, one roll of 10 meters and one roll of 5 meters. Total measured length: 90 meters. Invoice total: $540. The driver has left all seven rolls in receiving.

documents.title: Supplier to Rill · 10:00 Thursday
documents.text: We see why the two short rolls are a problem. We can exchange both for one 15-meter roll this morning at no extra charge. If you prefer to keep the short lengths for other work, the extra long roll will be billed separately at the original unit rate. Please confirm which arrangement you want.

questions.prompt: How many curtains can Rill make from the original shipment without a seam?
questions.evidence: five rolls of 15 meters each
questions.paraphrase: five continuous 15-meter pieces → five usable panels
questions.en: Only five rolls meet the 15-meter minimum. The two shorter rolls cannot be joined for these curtains.
questions.zh: 原送货只有五捆达到连续 15 米；两短捆不能拼接用于这些窗帘。

questions.prompt: Why is the invoice total consistent with the order even though the shipment is unsuitable?
options: Both short rolls were provided at no charge.
questions.evidence: Total measured length: 90 meters.
questions.paraphrase: 90 meters at $6 → billed $540
questions.en: The invoice uses the ordered total of 90 meters at $6 each. Suitability depends on individual lengths.
questions.zh: 总米数和单价对应 540 美元，但是否能使用还取决于各捆长度。

questions.prompt: What can Rill do to finish six panels without paying more?
questions.evidence: exchange both for one 15-meter roll this morning at no extra charge
questions.paraphrase: exchange → obtain the sixth usable length for free
questions.en: The exchange yields a sixth continuous 15-meter length at no extra charge.
questions.zh: 两短捆一起换一捆整 15 米长卷，可免费得到第六片所需长度。

questions.prompt: How much extra would the keep-and-buy option cost?
questions.evidence: extra long roll will be billed separately at the original unit rate
questions.paraphrase: 15 meters × original $6 → $90
questions.en: Keeping the short rolls requires buying a new 15-meter roll at the order's $6 rate.
questions.zh: 保留短捆就要按原价另购 15 米，每米 6 美元，共 90。

questions.prompt: Which deadline can the proposed exchange still meet?
questions.evidence: this morning at no extra charge
questions.paraphrase: Thursday morning → before Thursday noon
questions.en: The supplier's Thursday 10:00 email offers a morning exchange, before the order's noon deadline.
questions.zh: 供应商周四十点邮件承诺上午换货，仍赶得上订单中午截止。

documents.title: Reading Fair · volunteer certificates
documents.text: A certificate requires six credited hours. Visitor assistance and setup count in full. Meal breaks do not count. A travel period counts only if a coordinator assigns the volunteer to accompany fair equipment. Record the assignment in writing before travel.

documents.title: Dev Mills · Saturday
documents.text:
08:00–09:30  Set up the reading tent.
09:30–12:00  Helped visitors find talks.
12:00–12:30  Meal break.
12:30–13:30  Accompanied sound equipment to the second site.
13:30–14:15  Assisted visitors at the second site.

documents.title: Coordinator and Dev · Saturday
documents.text:
07:45 Coordinator: Please ride with the sound equipment at 12:30 and hand it to the second-site technician.
07:47 Dev: Understood. Is there any later work if I still need time for the certificate?
07:49 Coordinator: Yes. You can stay on the visitor desk after 14:15. Tell the desk lead when you finish so the extra time is recorded.

questions.prompt: Which period qualifies only because of the coordinator's written message?
questions.evidence: Please ride with the sound equipment at 12:30
questions.paraphrase: written assignment → eligible travel
questions.en: The recorded travel involved equipment, and the coordinator assigned it in writing before the trip.
questions.zh: 12:30–13:30 是运输时段，协调员事先书面派遣，所以符合工时条件。

questions.prompt: How much credited time has Dev earned by 14:15?
questions.evidence: Meal breaks do not count.
questions.paraphrase: 6 h 15 elapsed less 30 min break → 5 h 45
questions.en: The full span is six hours fifteen. Exclude the thirty-minute meal and include assigned equipment travel.
questions.zh: 8:00 到 14:15 共 6 小时 15 分，扣半小时午餐，指定随车时间可算，得 5 小时 45 分。

questions.prompt: How long should Dev stay at the desk after 14:15 to qualify?
questions.evidence: A certificate requires six credited hours.
questions.paraphrase: 6 h minus 5 h 45 → 15 min
questions.en: Dev is fifteen minutes short, and visitor assistance counts in full.
questions.zh: 距离六小时还差 15 分，访客服务按实际时间全计。

questions.prompt: Who should Dev notify at the end of the additional work?
questions.evidence: Tell the desk lead when you finish
questions.paraphrase: notify → tell
questions.en: The coordinator names the desk lead as the person who records the extra time.
questions.zh: 协调员要求 Dev 完工时告知服务台负责人。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Dev's reply in the chat?
options: To move the trip to the morning
To request a longer meal break
To ask about extra credited work
questions.answer: To ask about extra credited work
questions.evidence: Is there any later work if I still need time
questions.paraphrase: later work → opportunity to add credited time
questions.en: Dev accepts the assignment and asks whether a later task could fill a possible shortfall.
questions.zh: Dev 先表示接受派遣，再询问是否能用稍后的工作补足证书工时。

documents.title: North Mill hire · interruption credit
documents.text: If a hired press is unusable, we credit $12 for each complete hour from the time a fault is reported to the time a working replacement is made available. Fractions of an hour are discarded after the full interruption is measured. Time spent collecting an available replacement does not count. No credit is due for a fault first reported after the hire ends.

documents.title: Fault desk · press R16
documents.text:
09:05 Customer reports the press is producing uneven folds.
09:30 Technician confirms the press cannot be used.
11:50 Technician marks replacement ready at the customer's agreed collection point and notifies the customer.
12:35 Customer signs for the replacement.

documents.title: From: Arrow Bindery · same day
documents.text: Our hire runs until 17:00 today. The press had already stopped at 08:40, but we tried adjusting it before calling your desk. We sent a runner as soon as your notice arrived. The delay in reaching the pickup point was due to roadworks. Please calculate the credit under the contract.

questions.prompt: Which two times define the credit interval?
questions.evidence: from the time a fault is reported to the time a working replacement is made available
questions.paraphrase: reported at 09:05 → available at 11:50
questions.en: The contract uses the report time and availability time. The service record provides both.
questions.zh: 条款取报告故障与替机就绪的时刻，记录分别是 9:05 与 11:50。

questions.prompt: How much credit is payable?
questions.evidence: $12 for each complete hour
questions.paraphrase: 2 h 45 min → two complete hours at $12
questions.en: From 09:05 to 11:50 is two hours and forty-five minutes. Only two whole hours qualify.
questions.zh: 区间为 2 小时 45 分，取完整两小时，每小时 12 美元，共 24。

questions.prompt: Why do the roadworks leave the credit unchanged?
questions.evidence: Time spent collecting an available replacement does not count.
questions.paraphrase: road delay after availability → excluded travel time
questions.en: The roadworks affected pickup after the replacement was made available.
questions.zh: 道路施工发生在替机已就绪之后的领取途中，该段时间不计。

questions.prompt: What role does the 09:30 entry play?
questions.evidence: Technician confirms the press cannot be used.
questions.paraphrase: cannot be used → unusable fault confirmed
questions.en: The entry verifies unusability but does not change the reporting start specified in the contract.
questions.zh: 该条是技术人员确认停用，与合同所取的报告起算时间不同。

questions.prompt: Which fact establishes that the reporting deadline was met?
options: The press has a tested replacement.
questions.evidence: Our hire runs until 17:00 today.
questions.paraphrase: 09:05 report before 17:00 expiry → timely report
questions.en: The email sets the expiry at 17:00, and the desk logged the fault at 09:05 the same day.
questions.zh: 邮件表明当日 17:00 到期，故障在 9:05 已报，符合期限。

documents.title: Guild council · motion procedure
documents.text: A motion passes if it receives more votes in favor than against, provided at least eight voting members are present when the vote is taken. Abstentions count toward attendance but not toward either vote total. A member who steps out before the vote does not count as present. Observers cannot vote and do not count toward the eight.

documents.title: Tuesday council · registration
documents.text: Nine voting members signed in. Two observers also signed in. Mara, one of the nine voting members, left at 14:10. The secretary recorded no other departures or arrivals before the vote at 14:20.

documents.title: Secretary’s draft · funding motion
documents.text: At 14:20, four members voted in favor of the funding motion, three voted against and one abstained. The draft currently says the motion failed because fewer than five members supported it. Please check this sentence before the minutes are circulated.

questions.prompt: How many people count toward the attendance requirement at 14:20?
questions.evidence: Mara, one of the nine voting members, left at 14:10.
questions.paraphrase: nine members minus one departure → eight present
questions.en: One of nine voting members left before the vote. The observers do not count.
questions.zh: 九名有投票权者中一人提前离开，两名观察员不计，因此到会有效人数为八。

questions.prompt: What outcome follows from the rules?
options: The observers must break a tie.
questions.evidence: more votes in favor than against
questions.paraphrase: four in favor versus three against → majority of votes cast
questions.en: Eight eligible members were present, meeting the minimum. Four votes exceed three, so the motion passes.
questions.zh: 八人满足到会要求，四票赞成超过三票反对，故议案通过。

questions.prompt: How should the abstaining member be treated?
questions.evidence: Abstentions count toward attendance but not toward either vote total.
questions.paraphrase: abstention → included in head count only
questions.en: The rules explicitly distinguish attendance from a vote for or against.
questions.zh: 弃权者计入出席人数，但既不算赞成也不算反对。

questions.prompt: Why is the draft's reference to five supporters misleading?
options: It applies the wrong voting test.
It uses the wrong meeting time.
questions.answer: It applies the wrong voting test.
questions.evidence: fewer than five members supported it
questions.paraphrase: five-supporter test → absent from the stated procedure
questions.en: The rule requires more support than opposition, not five supporters irrespective of abstentions.
questions.zh: 规则比较赞成与反对数，不要求无论弃权情况如何都必须有五人赞成。

questions.prompt: When did Mara leave relative to the vote?
questions.evidence: left at 14:10
questions.paraphrase: 14:10 versus 14:20 → ten minutes before
questions.en: The register records 14:10; the draft and register place the vote at 14:20.
questions.zh: 签到表记录她 14:10 离开，表决是 14:20，相差十分钟。
